I and III are correct statements.

"Isotopes have the same mass number but different atomic numbers" is false, so II must be excluded.

The answer is I and III only.

text: Which of the following statements about nuclear reactions is correct? I. The energy released in a nuclear reaction comes from a loss of mass II. Nuclear reactions release far less energy than chemical reactions III. Isotopes have the same mass number but different atomic numbers

The other two statements are not true: "Nuclear reactions release far less energy than chemical reactions" and "Isotopes have the same mass number but different atomic numbers" both misstate the physics.

So only I is correct.
